commits.author: ccason
commits.subject: Replace harness globals with injected config; cache glob patterns
commits.body:
The harness config reached the lint delta pane through package-level globals
(harness.Active, ActiveRoot, and a worktreePrepared map reset by defer). Inject
it instead: Delta carries Harness, HarnessRoot, and a run-scoped Prepared set
that run.Run creates and shares with its own PrepareWorktree call, so a produce
root still runs at most once with no hidden state. PrepareWorktree takes the
dedup set as a parameter; active.go is gone.

globmatch.MatchesAny compiled a regexp for every pattern on every call, and it
runs once per changed path against the same scope patterns. Memoize the compiled
patterns so the diff does not rebuild them per file.

Also gofmt the opts struct alignment left by the module rename.

 type opts struct {
 	base, upstream, migDir, format, out, pr, branch, commit, revRange string
 	reportURL, profile, olderThan                                     string
-	open, noOpen, stop, dryRun, file, prepare, allowMissingCoverage          bool
+	open, noOpen, stop, dryRun, file, prepare, allowMissingCoverage   bool
 	port                                                              int
 }

diff --git a/internal/harness/active.go b/internal/harness/active.go
deleted file mode 100644
index feab39a..0000000
--- a/internal/harness/active.go
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,19 +0,0 @@
-package harness
-
-// Active is the harness config for the current redline run, loaded from the
-// caller's checkout so worktrees without a committed .redline.yml still get
-// worktree prepare steps. Set by run.Run; read by panes.
-var Active *Config
-
-// ActiveRoot is the repository root Active was loaded from. env.from paths
-// are resolved here when they are absent from the tree under review.
-var ActiveRoot string
-
-// worktreePrepared records produce roots that already ran harness.worktree
-// this run, so lint delta does not repeat stub-ui for head.
-var worktreePrepared = map[string]bool{}
-
-// ResetWorktreePrepared clears the worktree dedup map. Called at run end.
-func ResetWorktreePrepared() {
-	worktreePrepared = map[string]bool{}
-}
